title: Employees
description: Wages of the four kinds of staff, basic and skilled, from golf.exe's wage table at 0x4c2e2c (2 bytes per kind). A wage is charged per employee at every wage period (difficulty.wage_period) when a roll against the course grade passes. Money is in units of $100.

wage.description: Wage of the basic form, in $100 per wage period.

wage_skilled.description: Wage of the skilled form (Celebrity, Marshall, Technician, Refresher), in $100 per wage period.
